content: The execution was successful (Reward 1.0). The core logic for handling HWPX (a ZIP-based XML format) is robust: it correctly identifies that placeholders like `{{...}}` are frequently split across multiple `<hp:t>` (text run) elements within a paragraph `<hp:p>`. The solution successfully handles this by: 1) Concatenating all text within a paragraph, 2) Performing replacements on the full string, 3) Re-inserting the result into the first text node while clearing others, and 4) Removing `<hp:lineSegArray>` elements to force the HWP viewer to re-render the layout without cached artifacts. This approach ensures no partial placeholders (e.g., `{{pat` and `ient_name}}`) are missed.
